description: Create a new page in a wiki. If the page already exists at the specified path, it will be updated.

comment.description: Optional comment for the creation or update

content.description: The content for the new wiki page in markdown format

organizationId.description: The ID or name of the organization (Default: unknown-organization)

pagePath.description: Path of the wiki page to create. If the path does not exist, it will be created. Defaults to the wiki root (/). Example: /ParentPage/NewPage

projectId.description: The ID or name of the project (Default: no default project)

wikiId.description: The ID or name of the wiki

name: create_wiki_page
